description:
Time to get RUNE-WRITING as the Lumineth return to Warhammer: Age of Sigmar with an updated 4th Edition book that's got you picking scaling RUNES to add linear buffs to an already stat-heavy elite army of Aelves. Let's dive in and check out this year-three Age of Sigmar drop from GW. 

Big thanks to GW for a complimentary copy of the book and cards to review.
